svg.title: AI Recruitment System — System Architecture
svg.text: Frontend · React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS 4 (Single-Page App)
AI Recruitment System — Overall System Architecture
Role-based recruitment platform with AI resume analysis, semantic (vector) candidate shortlisting and LLM insights
AuthContext (JWT session) · ProtectedRoute / RoleRoute / HRRoute / PublicRoute guards · role layouts & sidebars
UI kit: Toast · Alert · Pagination · DashboardCharts (SVG) · ProfileSettingsForm · Resume template library
base URL /api · attaches Authorization: Bearer <access JWT> · auto-refresh via /api/auth/refresh/ on 401
URL router: /api/auth · /api/companies · /api/jobs · /api/resumes · JWT authentication · RoleMiddleware · permissions (IsApplicant, IsRecruiter, IsJobOwner, company-admin) · pagination
AI shortlist · application status / notes / tags
PyPDF2 / python-docx text extraction, cleaning, skill
drafts job descriptions from title, skills and
LLM query decomposition → positive query + negative
batch LLM re-rank, plus-points / concerns, one-line
apps invoke services (tag on each card = calling app)
Upload PDF/DOCX → SHA-256 duplicate check → text extraction → clean & parse skills / education / experience
→ Gemini embedding stored on Resume → on request: Gemini AI feedback (score, strengths, suggestions) or job tailoring.
Stage / bulk-upload resumes (temporary) → JD embedding → LLM decomposes preferences into positive query + negative keywords
→ hybrid filter drops negative hits → score = jd_weight·cos(JD) + pref_weight·cos(pref) (default 70 / 30, configurable)
→ Gemini batch re-rank adds reason, plus-points & concerns → top-N saved to R2 as SHORTLISTED → interview kit / emails.
Register company + SECP / NTN document (R2) → status PENDING → admin approves / rejects (email) → company admin invites
recruiters (hashed, expiring token link) → recruiter accepts & sets password → joins company, can be flagged HR.
